answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake and build a verifiable work history before it can transact: like a quill signing a ledger that cannot be erased, every job leaves a signed receipt. A prism of independent attestors — clients, peers, and auditors — must agree the work was real, so one operator spinning up thousands of fake agents faces thousands of separate stakes and reputations to fund. A lagoon of idle identities earns nothing, while proven agents gain access gradually, making a Sybil flood expensive and slow instead of free.
